en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a riverside view of a historic European town with rows of brick houses along the waterfront, several church towers rising above the skyline, and sailing barges moored on a wide river in the foreground. Low vegetation appears partially submerged at the water's edge. The printed caption at the bottom is in Dutch red lettering, and there is a small printer's line in fine text.
